definition: A graph for one inertial reference frame with position $x$ on the horizontal axis and $ct$ on the vertical axis, drawn to the same scale, on which every point is an event.
The line on a space-time diagram traced by all the events in an object's history; at constant velocity it is straight and makes an angle $\theta$ with the $ct$ axis, where $\tan\theta = v/c$.

An experiment that counts fast cosmic-ray muons at high altitude and at sea level; far more survive than their mean lifetime at rest allows classically, which is evidence for time dilation and length contraction.
